verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows many shipped SKILL.md files and a dev mode that symlinks a checkout into .claude/skills/. Nothing documents a template or authoring guide for a new SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter. Dev mode is a contributor workflow, /skillify codifies scrape scripts, and domain skills are notes the agent writes for itself; all of these are adjacent features, not a documented skill-authoring template.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
